evidence: The reference build, 14 submitted reference cases at O2 and O0, and four public cases against the reference exited 0; the intentionally incomplete starter public run exited 2 with the documented four failures.

The checker validates permitted PTE bits and exact frame counts separately but has no invariant that forbids WRITE when a frame has more than one reference.
